scope: Read-only upstream implementation study; no upstream code or dependencies copied or executed.

tools.name: m2c

capabilities.purpose: Deterministic matching-oriented GNU-as assembly-to-C source draft generator.
capabilities.known_compiler_assumption: Target selects IDO/GCC/MWCC/SHC defaults and target-specific patterns; does not invoke compiler.
capabilities.models_compiler_specific_behavior: yes, scoped to target architecture/compiler idioms
capabilities.outputs_compilable_source: best effort with valid-syntax; no recompilation guarantee
capabilities.relocation_fixup_handling: symbolic assembly/data expressions only; no object relocation comparison
capabilities.translation_unit_context: parsed declaration context and small cross-function type/output inference, no build/link model
capabilities.data_layout_reasoning: known globals/initializers from input sections; no object/link layout proof
capabilities.automation_level: automatic deterministic analysis under supplied context
capabilities.historical_x86_feasibility: architecture concepts reusable; 16/32-bit x86 segmented ABI/parser/pattern/OMF work would be substantial and still lacks oracle search
capabilities.reuse_constraints: GPL-3.0-only; reference/reimplement only pending licensing decision

findings.claim: Pipeline parses assembly/context, builds CFGs, iterates type inference and prints C without a compiler-oracle step.
CFG/IR architecture is reusable conceptually, whereas decoder, ABI and patterns are target-specific.

Type inference uses union-find unification across kind, signedness, size, pointer/function targets and access evidence; it can infer unknown struct fields by offset/size and later infer an unambiguous pointer target.

CFG reconstruction classifies branch kinds and symbolic jump tables, computes dominator/postdominator/natural-loop relationships, collapses reducible condition DAGs into if/else, recognises irregular switches and emits gotos when needed.
Compiler-idiom knowledge appears as explicit pattern rewrites, including MIPS IDO unrolled memcpy and PPC CodeWarrior struct-copy recognisers; it is not a generic historical compiler model.
LLM plus deterministic x86/OMF analysis is likely a more economical source prior for current local targets than a wholesale port, subject to measurement.

tools.reuse_decision: Learn from parsed-asm/typed-IR/CFG/context architecture; do not vendor or port before evidence and licensing decision.

tools.name: decomp-permuter

capabilities.purpose: Compile-and-score exploration of variants of supplied C.
input_formats: ELF object required by built-in scorer
capabilities.known_compiler_assumption: real compiler supplied through compile.sh; compiler type selects IDO/MWCC/GCC weights
capabilities.models_compiler_specific_behavior: limited weights and architecture-specific disassembly/relocation formatting
capabilities.automatic_retries: yes; finite seed enumeration or indefinite random mutation
capabilities.candidate_scoring: normalized objdump mnemonic alignment with weighted stack/branch/register/reorder/insertion/deletion penalty
capabilities.relocation_fixup_handling: uses relocation text to rewrite printed instruction only; no raw relocation identity/order/count
capabilities.translation_unit_context: single function search; compile script may use context but no explicit TU model
capabilities.data_layout_reasoning: not found in inspected scorer paths
capabilities.batch_candidate_exploration: yes; multiprocessing, multiple directories and optional permuter@home
capabilities.equivalent_output_deduplication: source score cache up to 100k; selected non-zero normalized objdump hash
capabilities.automation_level: automatic enumeration/randomization/compiler run; human supplies constraints and reviews
capabilities.historical_x86_feasibility: isolated 32-bit x86 ELF trial plausible; 16-bit OMF/NE/MZ and strict proof require adapters
capabilities.reuse_constraints: MIT, but normalized score must not replace strict project oracle

findings.claim: Manual macro spaces and weighted AST randomization provide exhaustive finite or stochastic candidate generation.
Score is normalized rendered objdump text rather than raw object equality.
Use only as a mechanical exploration layer after an adapter supplies context-aware identity and strict proof; it has no adaptive mechanism selection or retained diverse beam.

tools.reuse_decision: Consider only a small isolated compatible adapter trial; otherwise reuse exploration concepts, not the proof model.
